catalog.subtitle: Lawful console preservation, development, testing, and archival research
catalog.note: Names, descriptions and category structure are transcribed from the source catalog. `implemented_by` marks the skills this Skill Tool actually executes; every other skill is reachable through `guided-workflow` routing and its own category context.

routing_model.workbench-automated: executed directly by a tools-console-agent.py command
routing_model.workbench-assisted: the workbench produces or validates the artifact, but the observation needs external tools or hardware
routing_model.guided-workflow: the workbench supplies policy, plans, routing and reporting; execution needs external tools
routing_model.external-tool: requires a named third-party tool or SDK on a worker
routing_model.hardware-dependent: requires physical media, a reader, a physical console or a logic analyzer
routing_model.hardware-or-emulator-dependent: requires physical media/hardware, or a lawful emulator plus user-owned media
routing_model.official-program: requires an official partner program, licensed SDK or devkit
